body_markdown:
Hamilton, Bermuda, August 11, 2026


Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (the “Company”) has today filed its Unaudited Interim Financial Report for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, on Form 6-K, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


The report is attached to this release and can also be found on the Company’s website www.himalaya-shipping.com and the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission website, www.sec.gov.


This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
